summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the issuance of $2.25 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes by The Charles Schwab Corporation under its existing shelf registration. The offering comprised $1.0 billion of 4.744% fixed-to-floating notes due 2030 and $1.25 billion of 5.493% fixed-to-floating notes due 2037. Net proceeds were ~$2.236 billion after underwriting discounts and expenses. The underwriting agreement was with BofA Securities, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary financing with no change of control or strategic event.
